name: Sean O'Malley

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (71 in height, 72 in reach); fight weight = bantamweight limit 135 lb

face.shape: Long, narrow oval. Widest at the cheekbones and temples, tapering to a narrow chin that the beard lengthens further. Very lean with no facial fat, so the face reads long and angular.
face.jaw: Narrow to medium width, with a soft angle hidden under the beard. In the right profile (White House 55-57) the jawline slopes fairly steeply from ear to chin rather than running horizontal.
face.chin: Narrow and fairly long; projects moderately in profile (AP left profile). Always under beard in recent photos; no cleft visible in 2018.
face.cheekbones: Moderately prominent and set high, with clear hollows beneath them (most visible in the ESPN headshot and White House 29 crop).
face.brow_ridge: Moderate. Brows sit low and close over the eyes, which makes the eyes look deep-set and shadowed in studio light.
face.forehead: Medium height, fairly flat, mostly covered by hair or cornrows. Small tattoos at the hairline (see marks).

eyes.shape: Almond, slightly heavy-lidded with the upper lid partly hidden under the brow; lower lids show mild shadowing.
eyes.spacing: Average to slightly close (a bit less than one eye-width apart).
eyes.colour: Dark brown (ESPN headshot, White House 29). Closest MakeHuman iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight and low, with a slight downward slope at the inner ends that gives a frowning look at rest (ESPN headshot, stance-left).

nose.bridge: High and straight from root to tip in both profiles (AP left, White House right)
nose.tip: Moderately defined, slightly rounded and projecting; level, not upturned or drooping
nose.fight_damage: No obvious deviation or flattening visible.

face.mouth_lips: Medium-narrow mouth. Thin upper lip (largely under the moustache), medium lower lip. Corners sit level to slightly down at rest.

ears.size: Medium, sitting close to moderately out from the head
ears.cauliflower_ear: No obvious cauliflower ear in the AP left profile or White House right profile; helix looks normal.

face.marks_scars: Several small face tattoos (as of Jun 2026): a red-outlined heart followed by the word 'Love' in script just under the right eye; a small outlined star (green-black) on the left cheekbone; a short line of script above the left eyebrow at the hairline; small symbols/lettering on the right side of the forehead at the hairline and at the left temple. No obvious scars.

hair.style: Changes often. Current look (June 2026 media day, weigh-in and press week): a big, rounded mass of loose curls dyed magenta/hot pink, with deep red on his right side and royal blue on his left side and back. Fight night (June 14 2026): the same colours braided into tight straight-back cornrows ending in short braids at the nape (pink on top, blue on the left side). The earlier ESPN stance-right shoot shows undyed brown cornrows. Natural (2018): shoulder-length loose brown curls.
hair.length_note: About 15 cm stretched; the curls stand about 8-10 cm out from the scalp. As cornrows the hair lies flat (about 1 cm proud of the scalp).
hair.colour_note: Primary #a52e97 magenta-pink, secondary #2f5496 blue (his left side/back), accent #71000f red (his right side, curly look only). Natural colour medium-dark brown (#4a2f1c for render).
hair.hairline: Fairly straight across with mild recession at the temples (visible when braided, White House 29).

facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin, moustache and jaw edge; thinner on the cheeks, where it fades out well below the cheekbone.
facial_hair.shape: Short full beard about 1-1.5 cm, kept longer and fuller at the chin so it extends the chin downward into a slight point. Moustache connects to the beard at the mouth corners. Cheek line low and soft; neckline sits under the jaw.

tone_samples.where: same scene as the 29 crop (not in average)

skin.tone_note: Average of the first four samples (median of skin-classified pixels, shadows and highlights trimmed). Light skin with a light tan.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles visible; skin across the torso is heavily tattooed.

body.build: Tall and rangy for bantamweight: long legs, long torso and arms, narrow frame. Looks slim rather than bulky in every photo.
body.body_fat_note: Abs visible but soft-edged at the June 2026 shoot; very low fat, little muscle mass compared with most bantamweights.
body.shoulders: Medium width, sloping; deltoids defined but not large.
body.chest: Flat, lean pectorals, covered by the chest tattoo.
body.arms: Long and slim, wiry forearms; biceps small.
body.waist: Narrow; the torso is long between ribcage and hips.
body.legs_calves: Long, slim thighs and calves; knees bony. Long legs relative to torso (stance photos, B/W White House 58).
body.posture: Upright, relaxed, slightly forward-leaning head; often stands loose with shoulders dropped.
body.notable: Ectomorph build and long limbs are the main body likeness cues; avoid adding bulk.

tattoos.where: Chest, collarbone to collarbone and down to the nipple line
tattoos.description: Large colour piece: a bird with outstretched feathered wings in red, orange and green spanning the whole chest, with a green, ornate bird/owl-like head at the sternum. Black script 'doingwell' in small lowercase letters across the upper sternum just below the collarbones.

tattoos.where: Left side of abdomen and ribs
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey cobra coiled upward with lotus flowers below it (ESPN stance-right).

tattoos.where: Left ribs/flank, beside the left arm
tattoos.description: Large vertical black script running down the left ribs between the cobra and the left arm (word not legible; ESPN stance-right).
Stacked lines of black script reading 'Float like a Butterfly / Sting like a Bee' running down the right ribs (legible in the Cageside weigh-in photo; partly visible in ESPN stance-left).
Full colour sleeve: dense red, yellow and green imagery with a berry/holly-like plant motif on the upper arm and a colourful piece on the forearm.

tattoos.where: Right arm (partial, not a full sleeve)
tattoos.description: Upper arm mostly bare skin: a thin outline awareness ribbon with script on the inner biceps and a few small pieces. Forearm more heavily worked: a large shaded black-and-grey rose on the outer forearm below the elbow, dark black-and-grey work toward the wrist, a blackletter word on the inner forearm near the wrist, and letters on the knuckles (ESPN stance photos, White House 55-57, Cageside weigh-in, 2024 CC0 photo).
tattoos.size: forearm half-sleeve plus small upper-arm pieces

tattoos.description: A green shamrock/clover shape crossed by a black scroll banner of script on top of the right shoulder, the small word 'JOHN' beside it, '69' in black numerals on the rear shoulder, and a vertical column of large black script down the right side of the back (White House 55-57). Small black lettering on the front of the right shoulder (ESPN stance-left).
Black chess king drawn on its side on the right side of the neck (clear in White House 57); a black-and-grey figure on the left side of the neck (AP profile).
Heart and 'Love' under the right eye, star on the left cheekbone, small script above the left brow and small marks at the right hairline and left temple.

kit.fight_shorts_current: UFC Freedom 250 (Jun 2026): white shorts with thin light-blue diagonal pinstripes, red-and-white stripes on the lower left leg, navy waistband with white stars and UFC logo; red FREEDOM 250 gloves.
kit.fight_shorts_previous: Hot pink/magenta Venum shorts with a black snakeskin/halftone pattern and black waistband (ESPN stance-right, about 2025).
kit.gloves: Black UFC gloves normally; red in Jun 2026.

morphs_unavailable.note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ears/* targets. Ears are not a strong cue for him; if added use about ears/l|r-ear-scale-incr 0.05 and nothing else.
morphs_unavailable.limbs: Reach 183 cm at 180 cm; no change needed. Legs look long; if the rig allows, lengthen thighs and shins about 2%.

render_hints.hair: afro01 scaled down and tinted #a52e97 (with blue #2f5496 on his left side if per-vertex tint is possible) for the curly look; for fight night a tight cornrow look needs a custom texture over a near-bald cap
render_hints.beard: short beard texture or shell #45322c, fuller at the chin
render_hints.tattoos: Without tattoo textures the likeness drops sharply; a skin overlay with the chest bird, the full colour left sleeve, the right-forearm rose, the cobra and flank script, and the face marks is the top priority after hair. Keep the right upper arm mostly bare.

notes: Confidence: high for build, nose, eyes, beard and hair colours (many clear 2026 photos, several public domain). Medium for exact jaw and chin shape because the beard hides them. Watch for: (1) hair changes almost every fight; the June 2026 look is magenta curls/cornrows with blue on his left and red on his right, (2) keep him slim and long-limbed, (3) heavy tattoos on the chest, the full left sleeve, the right forearm, both flanks, neck and face are a core part of his look (the right upper arm is mostly bare), (4) the ESPN stance-right shoot (cornrows, pink shorts) predates 2026.

changes: Right arm corrected: not a full sleeve; upper arm is mostly bare, the work is on the forearm (rose, blackletter word) plus an outline ribbon on the inner biceps.
Neck tattoo is a chess king, not a knight; right-shoulder piece is a green shamrock with a script banner plus 'JOHN'.
Right-flank script is legible: 'Float like a Butterfly / Sting like a Bee'. Added the vertical script on the left flank.
